QuestInfo.name: Ulu City Energy Thieves
QuestInfo.0: Monsters are sapping energy from Ulu City's power reserves and using them to power up other monsters. They must be stopped!
QuestInfo.1:
#b#o9420519#s#k are stealing Ulu City's energy and using it to strengthen other monsters. They must be stopped. Hunt #b200 #o9420519#s#k and confiscate #b100 #t4000434#s#k, which is that they're using to transfer the energy.

QuestInfo.2: The war over Ulu City is ostensibly over, but #b#p9270044##k doesn't think real victory can be achieved until #b#o9420520##k is defeated.

0.0: Why, those sneaky little sneaks! They're sapping energy straight from #bUlu City's#k power reserves and channeling them to other monsters, doubling their strength!
0.1: Time to put an end to that. We'll take out the monsters transferring the energy first. Once they're gone, the other monsters will be too weak to be a threat.

yes.0: Hunt #b200 #o9420519#s#k and collect #b100 #t4000434#s#k. That's what they're using to do the energy transfers.
yes.1: When you're done, I'll give you a tool to help you find #b#o9420520##k, the baddest baddie in Ulu City. Now, go on!

no.0: Can't say I blame ya, but it doesn't mean I respect ya.

1.0: You weren't half bad, wiping out those #b#o9420519#s#k. We've got the advantage now.

yes.0: But there's something else going on, in a hidden area of #bUlu City#k. My gut tells me it's something dangerous. I sent a squad to investigate. Speaking of which, I should see how they're doing.

item.0: If you can't do it, no one can. Except me, and I'm too busy. Hunt down the rest of the monsters and bring back my items!
